headline: Touchstone Partners advises Tencent on exit from Swiggy
sum: Tencent Holdings has made an exit from Swiggy Limited by a block trade of its entire shareholding of 54.3 million shares for approx. $104 million.
detail: Tencent Holdings has made an exit from Swiggy Limited by a block trade of its entire shareholding of 54.3 million shares for approx. $104 million. Touchstone Partners advised Tencent on this block trade. The transaction was led by Sameeksha Chowla (Partner) and Mahak Goyal (Associate).

sources.name: Bar & Bench - Dealstreet
sources.blurb: Primary source naming the law firms, partners and teams on the matter.
